programs.name: Computer Science BASc (direct entry)
programs.a_level_offer: Minimum overall average grades of 'A' in all subjects required for consideration; Mathematics at the A2/International 'A' Level plus English (GCSE/IGCSE/O Level or A2). Admission is by selection; the minimum does not guarantee admission.
programs.ib_offer: A minimum of 36 is required for consideration (out of 45, including TOK and EE bonus points). Six subjects, three at HL and three at SL; English and Mathematics: Analysis and Approaches HL/SL or Applications & Interpretations HL (Applications & Interpretations SL does not satisfy the requirement).
programs.ap_offer: US curriculum: a minimum of 92% (based on a 60% pass grade, unweighted) is required for consideration. Required courses: Grade 12 English and Calculus (4 years of high school math including Pre-Calculus and Grade 12 Calculus or AP Calculus AB/BC). SAT/ACT optional. AP exam results (minimum score 3) may be requested as a condition of admission.
programs.required_subjects: English; Calculus (A2 Mathematics / IB Analysis and Approaches or Applications & Interpretations HL / AP Calculus AB/BC)
programs.admissions_test: Supplementary application required (due 28 Jan 2027); no admissions test listed
programs.toefl_note: TOEFL iBT: tests completed on or after 21 Jan 2026 (1-6 scale) need 4.5 overall with at least 4.0 in Reading, Writing and Speaking and 4.5 in Listening; tests before that (old 0-120 scale) need 86 overall with at least 20 in each component.
programs.english_note: McMaster university-wide minimum; a result is accepted for Sept 2027 entry if valid when the application is submitted. Duolingo (120 overall with sub-scores) is accepted.
programs.notes: Fall 2027 entry (the English page says 'September 2027 entry'; deadlines are for 2027). Data is taken from McMaster's Admission Requirements tool (https://future.mcmaster.ca/requirements/admission-requirements/): program 'Computer Science', 'Attending a School Outside Canada', with the British-patterned, International Baccalaureate and American-style curriculum options; OUAC code MC / MCC. Application deadline 15 Jan 2027 (recommended early 12 Nov 2026); supplementary application 28 Jan 2027 (details at eng.mcmaster.ca/supplementary-application); supporting documents, including English test, by 1 Apr 2027. Common curriculum rules: https://future.mcmaster.ca/apply/curriculum-requirements/ (unweighted GPAs, 80% minimum average for eligibility). FEE: intl_fee_cad 56233 is the 2026/2027 'Estimated tuition' (56232.60, full-time, tuition only, no ancillary fees) returned for 'Computer Science', Non-Canadian/International Visa Student, by McMaster's Cost Estimator (https://future.mcmaster.ca/finances/cost-estimator/), which the page calls unofficial estimates for 2026/2027; the official schedule is the Registrar's 2026-27 Undergraduate Fee Schedule (https://registrar.mcmaster.ca/fees/undergraduate/). Not a Fall 2027 fee.

programs.name: Honours Economics I (Social Sciences) BA
programs.a_level_offer: Minimum overall average grades of 'B' required for this program; Mathematics or Further Mathematics at the A2/International 'A' Level plus English. The minimum does not guarantee admission.
programs.ib_offer: 30-33 is required for consideration (out of 45, including TOK and EE bonus points). Six subjects, three at HL and three at SL; English and Mathematics: Analysis and Approaches HL/SL or Applications & Interpretations HL (Applications and Interpretations SL does not satisfy the requirement).
programs.ap_offer: US curriculum: mid- to high-80s (based on a 60% pass grade, unweighted) is required for consideration; admission is by selection. Required courses: Grade 12 English, Pre Calculus 12 and Calculus (AP Calculus AB/BC or Grade 12 Calculus). SAT/ACT optional. AP exam results (minimum score 3) may be requested as a condition of admission.
programs.required_subjects: English; Pre-Calculus and Calculus (A2 Mathematics / IB Mathematics / AP Calculus AB/BC)
programs.toefl_note: TOEFL iBT: tests completed on or after 21 Jan 2026 (1-6 scale) need 4.5 overall with at least 4.0 in Reading, Writing and Speaking and 4.5 in Listening; tests before that (old 0-120 scale) need 86 overall with at least 20 in each component.
programs.english_note: McMaster university-wide minimum; a result is accepted for Sept 2027 entry if valid when the application is submitted. Duolingo (120 overall with sub-scores) is accepted.
programs.notes: Fall 2027 entry. Data is taken from McMaster's Admission Requirements tool (https://future.mcmaster.ca/requirements/admission-requirements/): program 'Honours Economics I' (B.A., B.A. (Honours)), 'Attending a School Outside Canada'; OUAC code MLE; the tool lists 'Low-to-mid 80s' as the anticipated admission range for Ontario applicants. No supplementary application is listed. The tool gives 1 Apr 2027 as the application and supporting-document deadline for applicants outside Canada (Ontario high school applicants follow OUAC dates). FEE: intl_fee_cad 45158 is the 2026/2027 'Estimated tuition' (45158.40, full-time, tuition only, no ancillary fees) returned for 'Economics I', Non-Canadian/International Visa Student, by McMaster's Cost Estimator (https://future.mcmaster.ca/finances/cost-estimator/), which the page calls unofficial estimates for 2026/2027; official schedule: https://registrar.mcmaster.ca/fees/undergraduate/. Not a Fall 2027 fee.

programs.name: Engineering I (common first year; Mechanical Engineering Track available) BEng
programs.a_level_offer: Minimum overall average grades of 'A-B' in all subjects required; English, Mathematics, Chemistry and Physics, with Mathematics and either Chemistry or Physics at the A2/International 'A' Level. Admission is by selection; the minimum does not guarantee admission.
programs.ib_offer: A minimum of 34 is required for consideration (out of 45, including TOK and EE bonus points). Six subjects, three at HL and three at SL; English, Chemistry, Physics and Mathematics: Analysis and Approaches HL/SL or Applications & Interpretations HL (Applications and Interpretations SL does not satisfy the requirement).
programs.ap_offer: US curriculum: a minimum of 90% (based on a 60% pass grade, unweighted) is required for consideration. Required courses: Grade 12 English, Calculus, Chemistry and Physics (AP Chemistry / AP Physics, or two full years in each). SAT/ACT optional. AP exam results (minimum score 3) may be requested as a condition of admission.
programs.admissions_test: Supplementary application required (due 28 Jan 2027); no admissions test listed
programs.toefl_note: TOEFL iBT: tests completed on or after 21 Jan 2026 (1-6 scale) need 4.5 overall with at least 4.0 in Reading, Writing and Speaking and 4.5 in Listening; tests before that (old 0-120 scale) need 86 overall with at least 20 in each component.
programs.english_note: McMaster university-wide minimum; a result is accepted for Sept 2027 entry if valid when the application is submitted. Duolingo (120 overall with sub-scores) is accepted.
programs.notes: Fall 2027 entry. Common first year: apply on OUAC to 'Engineering I - Discovery Track' or directly to the 'Engineering I - Mechanical Engineering Track' (co-op available); the tool lists 11 direct-entry tracks. Data is taken from McMaster's Admission Requirements tool (https://future.mcmaster.ca/requirements/admission-requirements/): program 'Engineering' (B.Eng., B.Eng.Mgt., B.Eng.Society, B.Eng.Biosci.), 'Attending a School Outside Canada', with the British-patterned, International Baccalaureate and American-style curriculum options; Ontario applicants' anticipated range is min. 87%. Application deadline 15 Jan 2027 (recommended early 12 Nov 2026); supplementary application 28 Jan 2027 (recommended early 26 Nov 2026; details at eng.mcmaster.ca/supplementary-application); supporting documents including English test by 1 Apr 2027. FEE: intl_fee_cad 69354 is the 2026/2027 'Estimated tuition' (69353.54, full-time, tuition only, no ancillary fees) returned for 'Engineering I', Non-Canadian/International Visa Student, by McMaster's Cost Estimator (https://future.mcmaster.ca/finances/cost-estimator/), which the page calls unofficial estimates for 2026/2027; official schedule: https://registrar.mcmaster.ca/fees/undergraduate/. Not a Fall 2027 fee.
